description: Intent classification schema for the Universal AI Agent Plugin (Shopify build). Each user message is classified into exactly one intent AND one action of that intent. Every action carries its own description, entities and example utterances so similar actions can be told apart.

intents.name: registration_login
intents.description: User wants to create an account, sign in, sign out, or recover access.

actions.name: register
example_utterances: I want to create an account

actions.name: login
actions.description: Sign in to an existing account.

actions.name: forgot_password
actions.description: Recover access when the password is forgotten.

example_utterances: I want to create an account

intents.name: order_tracking
intents.description: User wants the status of one order or a list of their orders. Logged-in shoppers need no order number or email.

actions.name: track_order
actions.description: Where is ONE specific order, its delivery status, tracking or ETA. Use this for 'my order' / 'my package' questions, with or without an order number.

actions.name: list_recent_orders
actions.description: Show a LIST of the shopper's orders or their order history, not the status of one order.

intents.name: cart_management
intents.description: User wants to view or change the contents of their cart.

actions.name: add_item
actions.description: Put a product in the cart.
example_utterances: Add 2 blue shirts to my cart
I want to buy the linen tote

actions.name: remove_item
actions.description: Take one product out of the cart.
example_utterances: Remove the blue shirt from my cart
Delete the mug from my cart

actions.name: edit_quantity
actions.description: Change how many of a product are in the cart.

actions.name: view_cart
actions.description: Show what is in the cart.

example_utterances: Add 2 blue shirts to my cart
I want to buy the linen tote
Remove the blue shirt from my cart
Delete the mug from my cart

intents.name: warranty_claim
intents.description: User wants to file or check a warranty, return, or replacement claim. Logged-in shoppers need no order number or email.

actions.name: submit_claim
actions.description: File a NEW warranty, return or replacement claim for a purchased item.
example_utterances: This product arrived broken, I want a replacement
File a warranty claim, the zip is faulty

actions.name: check_claim_status
actions.description: Ask about the progress of a claim that was ALREADY filed.
example_utterances: What's the status of my warranty claim?
This product arrived broken, I want a replacement
File a warranty claim, the zip is faulty
What's the status of my warranty claim?

intents.name: product_search
intents.description: User wants to find products or get product suggestions.

actions.name: search_products
actions.description: Find products by name, category or attributes, optionally filtered by price, color or size.
example_utterances: Do you have this in blue?

actions.name: get_recommendations
actions.description: Suggest products PERSONALLY for this shopper, without naming what they want.

example_utterances: Do you have this in blue?

intents.name: policy_query
intents.description: User is asking about store policies rather than their own account or order.

actions.name: answer_policy_question
actions.description: Answer a question about a store policy.
example_utterances: Do you sell my data to anyone?
Do you sell my data to anyone?

intents.name: fallback
intents.description: Message doesn't clearly match any defined intent, or confidence is too low to act on. Agent should ask a clarifying question rather than guess.

actions.name: clarify
actions.description: Ask the shopper what they mean.
example_utterances: can you help me with something
can you help me with something

classification_output_format.intent: one of the intent names above
classification_output_format.action: one of that intent's action names
classification_output_format.entities: key-value object of any entities extracted from the message, kept in the language the user wrote them in
classification_output_format.requires_confirmation: boolean, copied from the matched action definition
classification_output_format.language: ISO 639-1 code of the language the user's message was written or spoken in, e.g. 'en', 'hi', 'pa', 'es', 'fr', 'ar'

below_threshold_behavior: route to fallback.clarify instead of guessing
